risks.risk: Microwave may not heat properly (magnetron/transformer issue) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video of the microwave running (e.g., heating a cup of water) with a timer/countdown visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not proven for heating performance (worst case: treat as not working until tested).

risks.risk: Grill mode may not work (burner/element failure) or may have weak output.
risks.proof: A short video of grill mode running with the grill indicator on and visible heating (or a temperature/heat test).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as microwave-only (worst case: grill not working).

risks.risk: Door seal/interlock may be faulty (safety switch issues).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing door closes firmly plus a power-on test where it starts normally; ideally show interlock behavior (it should not run with door open).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as potential safety/interlock fault (worst case: not safe/doesn’t start).

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/model year; affects comparables and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate/spec label (inside door frame or back) showing model number and wattage.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the lowest-confidence category (generic used countertop microwave/grill combo).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/spec label (model number + wattage).
Video of microwave mode heating (e.g., water test) with timer/display visible.
Video of grill mode running (grill indicator on) and showing it actually heats.
Photo of the interior (roof/ceiling area and turntable) and any damage/rust.
